text:
amy.partnerships: Quick sync - security & onboarding checklist for the SnowBridge connector (Snowflake DeltaShare -> Databricks + Qdrant). Goal: smooth marketplace launch + partner SI handoff next week. Reply with the item you own.

vik.engineering: I can own the security checklist and the cross-account role docs. Quick note: DeltaShare read roles need a limited STS trust policy for partner accounts; I'll paste a sample role later.

jorge.docs: I'll update the onboarding guide and add a \"security considerations\" section. Need the exact IAM trust JSON and the sample SQL used to generate DeltaShare manifests.

tara.gtm: Marketing needs a short compliance blurb for the tile: something like \"supports customer-managed roles and VPC-restricted connectors.\" Can we confirm wording?

marta.legal: Legal: confirm we don't include partner account IDs in public docs. Also we need partner logo approval for the marketplace tile; please collect SVGs and signed usage.

staging-bot: Staging env created: staging-snowbridge-sec-2026-03-20 (owner: vik.engineering). Access granted to partner-onboard SSO group.

vik.engineering: Sample minimal trust policy (will paste as gist): \n- AssumeRole for the delta-sharing-reader principal only\n- limited to s3:GetObject on shared manifest bucket\n- short-lived credentials via STS\nI'll link the exact JSON in 10m.

amy.partnerships: Jorge/Tara, docs + compliance blurb needed by Tue EOD to include in partner packet. Vik, can you also validate that VPC egress restrictions for Qdrant endpoints are documented?

vik.engineering: Yup - Qdrant endpoints support private-link & IP allowlist. I'll add the CIDR ranges and sample security group rules.

jorge.docs: Adding a \"how to create the read role\" walkthrough and a sample SQL extract for the DeltaShare manifest. Will also include a short troubleshooting section for variant/array columns.

tara.gtm: For the marketplace tile compliance line, propose: \"Customer-managed roles & VPC-restricted connectors supported.\" Short and clear. Marta, ok?

marta.legal: That line is fine. Please include: \"Contact legal@redwood for co-marketing approvals\" in the partner packet. Also attach partner logo checklist.

vik.engineering: Pasting gist links: trust policy gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/snowbridge-trust-policy (WIP). Security group example: https://gist.github.com/redwood/snowbridge-sg-ex.

jorge.docs: Linked the docs PR with trust policy and SG examples. Also added a note: if partners use long-running transactions, recommend snapshot isolation for consistent DeltaShare reads.

amy.partnerships: Owners recap:\n- vik.engineering: security checklist + role policies + SG examples (due Mon) :white_check_mark:\n- jorge.docs: onboarding + security section + troubleshooting (due Tue EOD) :white_check_mark:\n- tara.gtm: compliance blurb + partner packet copy (due Tue EOD) :white_check_mark:\n- marta.legal: logo/embargo review (in progress)

staging-bot: Demo runbook uploaded to staging: /runbooks/snowbridge-onboard-2026-03-20.md

vik.engineering: Quick compatibility note: we detected a schema edge with deeply nested VARIANT arrays that causes a missing vector on export; added a normalize flag to the connector to flatten arrays. PR #4782 opened.

amy.partnerships: Thanks folks. If legal clears logos today we can send partner packet tomorrow morning and lock SI onboarding sessions for next week. Keeping this thread as canonical. :calendar:
